description: This file defines the ProjectMembersController class, providing API endpoints for managing project members, including adding, retrieving, and deleting members within a project.

classes.name: ProjectMembersController
classes.description: API controller for managing project members, including endpoints to add, retrieve, and delete members for a specific project.

methods.name: AddProjectMember
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new member to a project based on provided userId.

methods.name: GetProjectMembers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all members associated with a specific project.

methods.name: DeleteProjectMember
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project member by their ID.
